text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Inari One! Inari One takes the 
lead! Inari One in front!! And she crosses 
the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Heh, heheh... Man, oh man... Winning is 
great and all... But I'm completely at my 
limit...!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I take the L this time. Honestly, I 
underestimated ya and got burned.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heh, heheh... How d'ya like that...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm only lettin' you have this one time, 
got it?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Next time we meet, I will ABSOLUTELY win. 
You'd better remember that."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(...Heh. Ain't that something? She's 
already looking ahead to the next 
race...!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Besides, that magnificent, dignified walk 
of hers. Compared to that, even though I 
won, I ended up letting my guard down—)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I sure learned a lesson today. The majesty 
of the JRA... Tama's sheer strength...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind... Next year, I'm 
definitely gonna get results in this race!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"And on top of that, I'm gonna show this 
Hanshin an even more stylish figure than 
today's!"
